selection_rationale: While K=2 yields the highest mathematical silhouette score (0.8958), it trivially separates 26 extreme outliers from 4,312 customers (99.4%), which provides no operational value for marketing. K=4 provides a highly actionable business segmentation: it distinguishes VIP B2B wholesale champions (13 customers, £127k spend), high-frequency loyalists (204 customers, £12.7k spend), active retail shoppers (3,054 customers, £1.35k spend), and churned at-risk buyers (1,067 customers, £479 spend), with a robust silhouette score of 0.6162.

Champions (High-Value).behavior: Ultra-high spend, weekly ordering, B2B wholesale buyers
Champions (High-Value).strategy: Dedicated account manager, customized bulk pricing, proactive order fulfillment

Loyal Customers.behavior: Frequent repeat buyers with consistent recent spend
Loyal Customers.strategy: Tiered loyalty rewards, early product launches, volume discounts
Loyal Customers.kpi_to_monitor: Average order value (AOV), Customer lifetime value (CLV)

Regular Customers.behavior: Active shoppers with moderate basket sizes and seasonal buying
Regular Customers.strategy: Product recommendation bundles, personalized email triggers, category cross-sell

At-Risk (Low-Value).behavior: Inactive for >200 days, low order count (1-2 purchases)
At-Risk (Low-Value).strategy: Win-back discount campaigns, satisfaction surveys, exit feedback
